title: Trustky
tagline: Trustky - Your private resume builder. Fetch credentials from GitHub, Worldcoin & more. Control visibility & encryption for ultimate privacy. Build your perfect resume with confidence. 🚀🔒
description:
Introduction:

Trustky is a groundbreaking resume builder that prioritizes privacy and data security. In an era where personal data is often vulnerable, Trustky empowers users to build their resumes with confidence, knowing their sensitive information is protected.

Features:

Privacy-Centric: Trustky puts the user in control. You decide what data to showcase and what to keep private. Fetch credentials from platforms like GitHub, LinkedIn, Upwork, and Worldcoin, and tailor your resume's visibility according to your preferences.

State-of-the-Art Encryption: Your data is safeguarded with cutting-edge encryption, including industry-standard AES. Trustky ensures that your personal information remains encrypted and inaccessible to unauthorized parties.

Customizable Visibility: With Trustky, you have the power to determine who can access your resume's encrypted sections. No compromises on your privacy - your portfolio, your rules.

Data Access Requests: Trustky facilitates secure communication between users. When someone wants access to your encrypted data, you receive a request and can grant or deny access as you see fit.

User-Friendly Interface: Building a resume is seamless and intuitive with Trustky's user-friendly interface. Present your skills and experience effortlessly, while maintaining control over your privacy settings.

Full Data Deletion: You retain complete ownership of your data. If you decide to delete your account, Trustky permanently removes all your information from its system.

Privacy Compliance: Trustky is committed to the highest standards of privacy and security. The platform adheres to GDPR and other data protection regulations, ensuring your data is handled responsibly.

How It Works:

Sign up for a Trustky account.

Grant permission to fetch credentials from GitHub, Worldcoin, and other platforms.

Customize the visibility of your resume sections based on your preferences.

Enjoy building your resume with complete control over your privacy and data security.

Contributing:

Trustky is an open-source project, and we welcome contributions from the community. If you have suggestions, bug reports, or want to contribute code, please follow our Contribution Guidelines.

Join Trustky Today - Your Resume, Your Privacy

Embrace a resume-building experience where trust and security go hand in hand. With Trustky, you can create a professional resume, knowing that your data remains private and secure. Say goodbye to privacy compromises and embark on a new journey of resume building with confidence and trust. Get started with Trustky today and take control of your resume-building experience. 🚀🔒
how_its_made: Trustky employs the cutting-edge lit protocol for encryption, decryption, and data access control. Worldcoin ensures proof of identity, while EAS (Ethereum Attestation Service) verifies data integrity through certificates validated by the server. Rest assured, your resume is built with top-notch security and privacy in mind. 🛡️🔒
